summary.en: Put the question most readers have first on the overview page: was the customer data of Hong Kong companies leaked? We found no evidence of it. The files hold PingCAP’s own records about these companies (accounts, billing, sales leads, support tickets), and we found no sign of the companies’ own customer or user records. This is “no evidence found”, not “proven safe”: only part of the files has been checked, and their authenticity and completeness are not established. Some Hong Kong-linked personal details, mostly sales contacts and analytics profiles, are in the files and are still counted only as totals. No figures changed.
summary.zh-Hant: 在總覽頁最前面回答大多數讀者最關心的問題：香港公司客戶的資料有被外洩嗎？我們沒有發現這方面的證據。檔案裏是 PingCAP 自己與這些公司往來的紀錄（帳戶、帳單、銷售線索、支援工單），我們沒有發現這些公司自己的客戶或用戶紀錄。這是「未發現證據」，而不是「證實安全」：我們只檢視了檔案的一部分，也未能確立檔案是否真確或完整。檔案裏確有一些與香港有關的個人資料，主要是銷售聯絡人和分析設定檔，仍然只計算總數。所有數字沒有變動。

summary.en: Reworked the company findings page. Instead of nine selected companies, it now has a profile for every company whose account matches billing records by exact ID: 18 in all, listed alphabetically. Each profile says what kind of Hong Kong connection public sources show (a Hong Kong-registered company, a company that says it is based in Hong Kong, or a Hong Kong brand or group). The nine new profiles use evidence that was already in the downloads, and public sources for four of them were checked for this release. A profile doesn’t show that a company’s systems or customers were affected.
summary.zh-Hant: 重整公司個案頁面。頁面不再只列出九家選定的公司，而是為每一家帳戶能以完全吻合的編號與帳單紀錄配對的公司提供簡介，共 18 家，按字母順序排列。每份簡介都說明公開資料顯示它與香港有何種關聯（香港註冊公司、自稱以香港為基地的公司，或香港品牌或集團）。九份新簡介所用的證據原已載於下載檔案，其中四家的公開資料是為這次發布而查核的。有簡介並不表示該公司的系統或客戶受影響。

summary.en: Added two more BigQuery reviews and updated the reviewed-table count to 1,876 of 6,458 (about 29%, up from the 117 shown before; it now also counts the analytics export added in 0.4.1). A pseudonymised analytics export (878 sources, 15,296,605 rows) lists Hong Kong as the country in 944,248 rows and as the city in 827,674; this is a separate row count from the 38,546 and 416 already reported, not a number of people, not de-duplicated, and it may overlap with them, so the counts shouldn’t be added. A review of how six marketplace tables link by identifier adds no location or company findings. It adds no new affected company and doesn’t show that any Hong Kong business was affected.
summary.zh-Hant: 新增兩項 BigQuery 檢視，並把已檢視的資料表數目更新為 6,458 個中的 1,876 個（約 29%，先前顯示為 117 個；現已包括 0.4.1 加入的分析匯出資料）。一份假名化分析匯出資料（878 個來源、15,296,605 列）中，有 944,248 列的國家為香港、827,674 列的城市為香港；這與先前已報告的 38,546 及 416 是各自獨立的資料列數，不是人數，亦未作去重，可能互相重疊，所以不應相加。另一項檢視六個市集資料表如何以識別碼互相連結，沒有帶來地點或公司方面的發現。它沒有增加任何新的受影響公司，也沒有顯示任何香港企業受到影響。

summary.en: Added a review of the BigQuery analytics user export (875 sources, 3,068,700 rows) and updated the headline Hong Kong figures. 38,546 rows in that export list Hong Kong as their country, next to the 416 Mixpanel profile rows already reported. These are separate row counts, not people, they weren’t de-duplicated, they may overlap, and they shouldn’t be added together. It adds no new affected company and doesn’t show that any Hong Kong business was affected.
summary.zh-Hant: 新增對 BigQuery 分析使用者匯出資料（875 個來源、3,068,700 列）的檢視，並更新香港的主要數字。該匯出資料中有 38,546 列的國家欄位為香港，與先前已報告的 416 筆 Mixpanel 設定檔資料列並列。這些是各自獨立的資料列數，不是人數，亦未作去重，可能互相重疊，不應相加。它沒有增加任何新的受影響公司，也沒有顯示任何香港企業受到影響。

summary.en: Added a review of the source-code repository archive. It adds detail to four of the nine company findings (stored finance rows and configuration), explains how earlier exports were built and why their rows repeat, and notes saved profile data. It adds no new affected companies, and nothing reviewed shows a customer database was taken.
summary.zh-Hant: 新增對原始碼儲存庫壓縮檔的檢視。它為九家公司個案中的四家補充了細節（儲存的財務資料列及設定），說明較早匯出資料是如何產生的、為何資料列會重複，並註明已儲存的個人檔案資料。它沒有增加任何新的受影響公司，所檢視的內容亦沒有顯示客戶資料庫曾被取走。

summary.en: Rewrote the whole site for general readers: a plain-language overview with a “what you can do” section, a company search with plain labels, one card per closely examined company, a clear account of what was and wasn’t checked, and a shorter technical section. Evidence downloads are unchanged.
summary.zh-Hant: 為一般讀者重寫整個網站：淺白的總覽及「你可以怎麼做」、用語簡單的公司搜尋、每家仔細檢視公司一張卡片、清楚交代檢查範圍，以及精簡的技術附註。證據下載檔案維持不變。

summary.en: Added complete, expandable report contents and return links so readers can find every company observation, record type and review limit. Evidence and findings are unchanged from the preceding release.
summary.zh-Hant: 新增可展開的完整章節目錄及返回連結，方便讀者找到各項公司觀察、資料類型及檢視限制。證據與發現沿用上一版本，沒有改動。

summary.en: Integrated validated BigQuery reviews of commercial and support associations, stored-field presence, document and billing-model structure, numeric precision, and additional company-name context. Identity, historical ownership and incident-impact limits remain explicit.
summary.zh-Hant: 整合已通過驗證的 BigQuery 檢視結果，包括商業及支援紀錄關聯、儲存欄位存在情況、文件與計費模型結構、數值精度，以及新增公司名稱背景。明確保留身分、歷史擁有關係及事件影響的解讀限制。

summary.en: Added a plain-language reading guide, clearer count explanations and a glossary for readers without a technical background. Evidence and company findings are unchanged.
summary.zh-Hant: 新增白話閱讀指南、數字解說及用語解釋，方便沒有技術背景的讀者理解。證據與公司相關發現維持不變。

summary.en: Added precise release timestamps and integrated validated BigQuery coverage and two reviewed corporate labels, preserving the limits on identity and incident attribution.
summary.zh-Hant: 新增精確版本時間，並整合已通過驗證的 BigQuery 涵蓋範圍及兩個經檢視的公司名稱，同時保留身分核實與事件歸屬的限制。
